results.name: field additions, removals, metadata, property deletion, controls and order reconstruct exactly
stale or tampered base is rejected even with the same snapshot token
document, URL, missing context and duplicate-ref changes retain full result
unverified writes and unknown execution errors retain full observation and evidence
partial success preserves all unresolved source targets, candidates and evidence
wire normalization tolerates undefined properties and object key ordering
stored real-page receipts retain every non-observation decision and unresolved fact
